text:
**Short answer:** For the slimmest option that still charges fast, get the **Anker Nano 5K**. If you want more capacity and 25W charging, get the **INIU SnapGo Air 10K**. The iPhone 17 supports Qi2.2 at 25W, but only 10K models like the SnapGo Air offer that speed.

**Top picks**

1. **[Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)** is the best slim all-rounder.
   - It's 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless and 20W wired charging. Anker lists it as $54.99.
   - 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than competitors ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)).
   - Macworld says 5K packs usually recharge a phone 60-75%, which is enough to get you to the next outlet ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).

2. **INIU SnapGo Air 10K (25W Qi2.2)** is the best slim option with more capacity.
   - It's about 0.5" thick and 195g, with 25W wireless and 45W wired charging. It includes a built-in lanyard-style cable.
   - Android Central lists it at $42.99-$48.99 ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
   - Macworld names it an equal-slimmest 10K pack ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)).
   - The article didn't include direct buy links, so check the retailer listings there for current pricing.

3. **Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)** is the thinnest and lightest, at 0.27" and 104g.
   - Its wireless speed is only 7.5W, so it charges more slowly than the Anker.
   - Android Central lists it at $52.99-$69.99 ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).

**Other options**
- **[Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, 25W)](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)** has 45W wired output. With code AM52 it's $53.99, down from $59.99, according to the deal site's cart test on 2026-10-24. The listing doesn't give its thickness, so I can't confirm it's slim. This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. [Listing details](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w).
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K)** is 0.57" thick with 15W wireless and IP54 dust and water resistance. It's $69.99-$79.99 ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).

**Caveats**
- Thin packs hold less, so pick 10K if you need more than one charge.
- Prices change, so confirm at checkout.
- Some Anker page text mentions only iPhone 12-16 compatibility, but its spec list includes the iPhone 17 series at 15W.
- A thick or non-magnetic case can weaken the connection.
